items.title_orig: Zack I’m sitting on Pearl Jam history and wonder if you want it!
items.article_text:
Was watching the show the other day and totally forgot my husband has a piece of Pearl Jam history. We have Mike Mccready RockBox boiling point overdrive. My husband got it from his friend who’s brother worked at the studio where Pearl Jam would hang. We live in Seattle so this isn’t that crazy. The peddle is even taped to the same setting that are shown in the picture of Mike literally pointing at the peddle on stage. We don’t really care about Pearl Jam and my husband plays in metal bands so he’s trying to pass it along. My husband has been sitting on this thing for at least a decade. Zack we’d love to pass along this piece of Pearl Jam gear to a fan! 
    submitted by    /u/adult_techno    to    r/h3h3productions
